caption: The video captures an underwater view looking upward toward the water surface. A bright sun disc sits near the top center, and pale god-rays fan down through deep blue water. The rippling surface fills the upper portion of the frame with shimmering caustic reflections that continuously deform and pulse in intensity. Numerous small bright bubbles and particles hang suspended throughout the mid- and lower-water column. These specks drift steadily upward toward the surface across the sequence, with several also shifting laterally so their positions within the view change from one moment to the next. The overall framing of the surface and sun wobbles subtly, while the sun disc remains roughly top-center throughout. Individual bubbles change their focus and blur as they move, and the particle field persists, though some bubbles exit at the top edge while new ones emerge at the bottom. The upward motion continues steadily through the visible portion of the clip, neither starting nor stopping within it. The deepening blue of the lower water and the bright glare overhead stay constant as the gentle drift proceeds.
